text:
maria: Heads up — we're planning a breaking change in the partner SDK (v3) next month: removing the legacy /v1/handshake and replacing it with a token-based client-init flow. Need to align marketplace vendors, SI integrators, and HW partners on timing and migration paths.
anna: Thanks — can you paste the exact client change? partners will want a patch vs major recommendation.
maria: Sure:
```
// old
POST /v1/handshake
Body: { partner_id, shared_secret }
// new
POST /v3/client/init
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <partner-token>
Body: { client_meta }
```
kevin: We'll provide a compatibility shim for 90 days that accepts /v1/handshake and exchanges for a v3 token. It adds ~10ms. Ops ok with that?
jon: Marketplace packaging note — some cloud marketplaces require a 30-day notice for listed integrations. We should avoid an announcement window less than 45 days.
anna: Hardware partners (NimbleCompute) usually need firmware bundle updates that take 6 weeks to certify. We should offer a test-only endpoint for them.
maria: Proposal:
- Deprecation announcement in 7 days
- Migration docs & SDKs out in 14 days
- Compatibility shim active for 90 days after v3 launch
- Partner-only test endpoint immediately
jon: +1 on timeline. Also coordinate joint press/marketplace rollout: restrict public deprecation note until partner certs complete.
erin: Legal: need to check contract SOWs for any incompatibility clauses. I'll run a quick sweep; might need partner opt-in to token flow in some SLAs.
partner_success_bot: @maria Added task: 'partner-sdk-v3-migration' assigned to @anna, due 2026-05-15. Link: https://tasks.redwood.ai/t/12345
anna: I'll schedule a partner sync 3pm PST tomorrow. Agenda: migration path, shim behavior, marketplace timing, docs signoff.
kevin: Dev note: we'll add an environment var REDWOOD_PARTNER_SHIM=false to opt-out after deprecation window.
maria: Can product and partnerships prepare a joint migration checklist? I can draft initial version.
jon: I'll own marketplace sequencing and announcement gating.
anna: Thanks. Maria — can you share a short changelog + sample request/response for partner engineers before tomorrow?
maria: Yep — I'll drop a short RFC in #partnerships-docs and tag you all.
kevin: I'll post a short code snippet for shim integration into partner agent images.
anna: Great. See you tomorrow. :thumbsup:
